# Unstructured Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.unstructured` |
| Source | `09_docker/unstructured.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, document |

Unstructured.io API for partitioning documents into normalized elements. Used in the
ingestion pipeline as an alternative or complement to Tika for layout-aware parsing.
